title: Penthouse September 1981 Special Anniversary Issue Complete w/ Centerfold
conditionDescription: Complete w/ centerfold. Cover bright with light wear; small scuffs along the spine and corners. See photos.
descriptionText:
Penthouse magazine, September 1981 - Special Anniversary Issue with the sunset silhouette cover. Original $2.50 cover price. Complete w/ Centerfold.

Back cover: Tareyton Lights cigarette ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
